meta.title: PDF workbench
meta.description: One local workbench for PDFs: convert to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images and text; merge, split, compress, protect, rotate and renumber pages; resize every page to a standard paper size, unify sizes across many files, crop white margins, add watermarks and page numbers; OCR, extract images and outlines; and AI summary, Q&A, translation, proofreading and structured extraction.
